# Farsio

> Farsio (فارسیو) is a Persian-first AI product ecosystem for writing, reading, speech, translation and language productivity.

Canonical website: https://farsio.ir/
Persian: https://farsio.ir/fa
English: https://farsio.ir/en

## Products

### NeveshtYar · نوشت‌یار
Persian-first writing assistant for:
- Persian writing
- Finglish to Persian conversion
- Persian and English keyboard-layout recovery
- text editing and rewriting
- Persian language productivity

Persian:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/neveshtyar

English:
https://farsio.ir/en/products/neveshtyar

### AvaYar · آوایار
Persian-first reading and speech assistant for:
- reading web content
- Persian text-to-speech
- translation
- summarization
- listening workflows

Persian:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/ava

English:
https://farsio.ir/en/products/ava
